=== Morphological Assessment Form ===
A. Leaf Arrangement & Architecture
    1. Leaf relative position (alternate / opposite / whorled): opposite (clearly visible pairs of leaves attached at the same node along the stem)

B. Leaf Complexity
    3. Leaf complexity (simple / compound): simple (leaves are undivided blades attached to the stem)

    16. Petiole features (winged / grooved / terete): terete (cylindrical in cross-section)
D. Stem & Shoot Traits

    18. Stem trichomes (present / absent): absent (stem surface appears smooth)

    20. Stem texture (smooth / ridged / lenticellate): smooth
E. Other Visible Seedling Traits
    21. Stipules, sometimes visible only in close-up images (present / absent): absent (no stipules are visible at the leaf nodes)
    22. Latex, rarely visible but extremely diagnostic when present (present / not observed): not observed
    23. Pulvinus, for Fabaceae family only (present / absent): absent
    24. Tendrils (present / absent): absent
F. Notes: Several leaves exhibit distinct holes and missing sections along the margins.
